instruction: Create a new sheet named "Summary" with merged cells A1:B1 containing the text "Investment Data".

metadata.explanation: Task requires creating a new sheet 'Summary' with A1:B1 merged containing 'Investment Data'. Evaluator verifies: (1) Sheet 'Summary' exists, (2) A1:B1 are merged, (3) A1 contains 'Investment Data'.

llm_judge_reasons: Critical merge detection logic error at line 43: 'merge_cell in ws.merged_cells' will not work correctly as ws.merged_cells is a collection of CellRange objects, not a simple container of cell addresses

The isinstance(cell, MergedCell) check is also flawed: when cells are merged, the top-left cell (A1) remains a regular Cell object with the value, while other cells in the range become MergedCell objects. Checking if A1 is a MergedCell will return False
The merge verification will likely fail at runtime even when cells are correctly merged, making the evaluator unable to properly verify the instruction's merge requirement
Text content check (line 49-51) is correct and will work properly
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Fix merge detection logic at line 43 to properly check if the A1:B1 range exists in ws.merged_cells.ranges
Use: merge_range = f'{merge_cell}:{merge_end}'; is_merged = any(str(mr) == merge_range for mr in ws.merged_cells.ranges)
Alternative approach: use ws.merged_cells.ranges iterator and check if the expected CellRange matches any merged range
Test the merge detection logic with openpyxl's actual API behavior to ensure it correctly identifies merged cells
